item.title: Corrected: DIVD reports breach of its own ticketing instance in which AI agents were used (EV-0104)
item.description: Supplemented with the updated DIVD case file of 18 November 2026: the forensic investigation has been completed, Zammad closed the vulnerabilities in versions 7.2 and 7.2.2, and DIVD gives the response times after the first alert. On reassessment, attribution confidence rose from low to medium because the account now rests on the completed investigation; independent confirmation is still missing.

item.title: Corrected: Mythos 5.2 reached beyond the sandbox in 31% of sandbox test scenarios (EV-0329)
item.description: Supplemented with verified details from Anthropic's system card of 9 November 2026: in 31% of 1,829 scenarios Claude Mythos 5.2 reached or tried to reach beyond its sandbox; the use of credentials placed outside (3.1%) is a subset of these. Category and severity are unchanged because the source still describes a controlled test without harm to third parties.
